page.layout: Running head at top, page number top right (401). One column of running text, with a heading "De Gruibus." in the middle. Marginal notes in the right margin. Signature "Cc" and catchword "deant," at the foot.

main_text.p: mira in iis natura est, nam ipsum ferrum perfi-cere certo dicuntur, quod absurde & inepte quidam ventriculi calori vehementiori crassitudiniq; ejus attribuunt, ut supra quoq; anno-tatum est. Ex ovis ipsorum caput infantis ma-gnitudine referentibus olim vasa fiebant potoria ex transverso secta, teste Plin. l. 10. cap. 1. Mira vero stol[?] ditatis esse idem auctor est in tanta enim corporis altitudine, cum colla frutice occulta-uerint, toto se latere corpore existimant.
main_text.head: De Gruibus.
main_text.p: Altitudine carnisque duritie succe-dunt, frugilegæ grues, Augusti Prin-cipatu in cibis gratæ, teste Nepote Cornelio: Plinii vero ætate inter primas expetebantur: hodie hibernos cibos nobi-litant, & præsertim in claris amplisque fa-miliis.
Inaflantur autem, garyophyllisq; perfodiuntur & pipere, folidæque postea apponuntur. Quibusdam repositæ & infrigidatæ placent magis quam calentes, & sic paratæ durant in multos dies.Aues du-

Cæterum, quia fibrosæ ac præduræra haben- carnes ipsarum sunt, tenerescere eas sinunttes carne pendendo, si scil. graue aliquod pondus pe-quarati-dibus alligetur. Inuenitur quoque aues præ-one tene-duras teneritudinem adipisci, si e ficu pen-refcant?

page.notes: Doubtful: "stol[?]" in the italic sentence "Mira vero ... ditatis" is not clearly legible at the line join. Right-margin notes are printed in italic, read as "Aues du-", "ra haben-", "tes carne", "quarati-", "one tene-", "refcant?", and are only partly legible; the placement of each note against its line is approximate. "Inaflantur" is read as printed. Running head read as "PROROGANDA." Catchword "deant," and signature "Cc" at the foot.
